name: Manhattan Megaminx Mayhem 2026
information: The Daffodil and Seahorse classrooms have limited space and seating, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest in order to maintain safety and the pace of the competition. This will be strictly enforced to ensure we can provide a pleasant experience to all competitors. Guests are welcome to sit outside the classroom at the "Living Room" area. This area is a Public Open Space, please keep your belongings with you at all times.
